component_map.name: SiteHeader (Glassmorphic Architectural Navigation)
component_map.role: Global brand header and viewport orienter
features: Dynamic glassmorphic blur background on scroll (`rgba(248, 243, 234, 0.86)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(14px)`)
Scroll horizon progress hairline (`--scroll-progress`)
Auto-hide on downwards scroll past 220px, restore on upwards scroll
Mobile collapsible drawer with focus trap, aria-expanded, aria-controls, Escape dismissal
Exact language switcher preserving route, anchor hash, and accessibility semantics
component_map.reduced_motion: Disables hide/reveal translation, keeps fixed position, retains standard solid background transition

component_map.name: CinematicHero (Architectural Product Framing)
component_map.role: Flagship visual arrival and brand declaration
features: M29/M34 high-resolution master photography with travertine relief texture
Restrained GSAP entrance choreography: subtitle -> h1 split -> CTA button fade-up
Bilingual editorial typography (Jost for Latin, Noto Sans Arabic with 0 letter-spacing and 1.55 line-height for Arabic)
Quarter-arc decorative vector framing subtly anchoring product silhouette
Status badge: 'Commercial availability not established / التوافر التجاري غير مؤكد'
component_map.reduced_motion: Instant opacity fade (no transform parallax, video background replaced with static WebP)

component_map.name: CollectionStudio3D (Three.js WebGL Interactive Inspection)
component_map.role: Interactive 360° product examination studio for hotel operators and specifiers
features: Lazy-loaded Three.js WebGL canvas (initiated via IntersectionObserver when studio is within 200px of viewport)
Five-product instant model switching (Shampoo, Conditioner, Body Wash, Body Lotion, Hand Wash)
360° horizontal drag-to-inspect with inertial damping (`OrbitControls` with polar angle limits 30° to 105° to maintain architectural ground plinth)
Lighting Environment Presets: (1) Studio Lookdev (crisp key light), (2) Warm Suite (2700K hospitality ambient), (3) Architectural Daylight (high-key travertine sun)
Interactive 3D Inspection Hotspots: (1) Amber Glass Optical UV Protection, (2) Satin Pump Ergonomics & Actuation, (3) Bilingual Screen-Printed Label
Honest status badges: M29 verified geometry (`VERIFIED SPECIFICATION`) vs M34 exploratory geometry (`PROVISIONAL GEOMETRY` - strictly zero forbidden concept wording)
Full static fallback: High-resolution M29/M34 photographic plates rendered automatically if WebGL is unsupported or `prefers-reduced-motion` is active
component_map.reduced_motion: WebGL interactive canvas is disabled; renders high-res static plate with accessible keyboard tab buttons for products and text-based hotspot callouts

component_map.name: ScrollCollectionReveal (GSAP ScrollTrigger Sequence)
component_map.role: Narrative scroll sequence presenting the five-product family
features: Horizontal/pinned scroll progression through the five hospitality products
Product index counter (01 to 05) with synced metadata card
Subtle focal depth shifts and scale choreography
Direct CTA linking to B2B specification brief with product pre-selected
component_map.reduced_motion: Standard vertical stack of cards without scroll hijacking or pinned viewport

component_map.name: AmenitySpecificationTable (Technical Operator Grid)
component_map.role: Granular technical specifications for hospitality operators, housekeepers, and procurement
features: Structured comparison matrix across all 5 products
Columns: Product Name, Bottle Volume (ml / fl oz), Material Composition, Optical UV Rating, Dispenser Compatibility, Verification Status
Status Badges: 'Verified Standard' (Shampoo, Conditioner) vs 'Provisional Specification' (Body Wash, Body Lotion, Hand Wash)
Responsive horizontal table scroll with gradient shadow cues

component_map.name: FormatCards (In-Room, Wall-Mount, Travel Formats)
features: Three distinct formats: (1) In-Room Vanity Plinth, (2) Tamper-Proof Wall-Mounted Bracket, (3) Travel Presentation Kit
Hover micro-interactions: card elevation (`translateY(-6px)`), image scale (`1.035`)
Accessible lightbox trigger on image click/keypress

component_map.name: ProcurementBriefTool (Zero-Transmission B2B Specifier)
component_map.role: Confidential local project brief generator for hotel developers and purchasing teams
features: Form fields: Contact Name, Property/Hotel Group, Official Email, Geographic Market, Project Program, Key Count/Room Estimate, Specific Message
Strict client-side generation: `preventDefault()`, no data leaves the browser
CSP enforced: `form-action 'none'`, `connect-src 'none'`
Outputs formatted plaintext specification into readonly `<textarea id='brief-text'>`
Copy to clipboard with status announcement (`navigator.clipboard.writeText`)
Offline brief download (`GEM-project-brief-[lang].txt` via Blob URL)
Graceful fallback: Selects and highlights text if clipboard permission is denied

component_map.name: SiteFooter (Monochrome Architectural Foundation)
features: Monochrome Ink `#12171D` background with white typography
GEM vector wordmark and brand statement
Navigation shortcuts (B2B Project Inquiry, Privacy Policy, Language Switch)
Bilingual copyright and brand signature (`HOSPITALITY, IN PERFECT PROPORTION`)
